sentences.text: It is submitted that even in the present case earlier the allegation was only under Section 354 of IPC, however, subsequently the other day the prosecutrix has changed her version and she has stated that the applicant also sexually assaulted her.

Counsel has submitted that in the FIR lodged by the applicant's side, applicant Rajkumar and his mother Kanta Bai have also suffered injuries and the charge-sheet has already been filed and no further custody of the applicant is required in the case.

Counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the prayer and it is submitted that in the MLC it is apparent that the prosecutrix was assaulted by the applicant, however, it is not denied that there is no injury on her private part.
On due consideration of submissions, perusal of the case-diary and the different statements recorded by the prosecutrix, this Court is inclined to allow the present application.
Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.

However, it is also observed that subsequently if the FSL/DNA report is received by the trial Court and if it is found that the FSL/DNA report is positive and ties the applicant with the offence, he shall surrender before the trial Court immediately and this order shall stand cancelled without further reference to the Court.
Certified copy as per rules.
